home.description: Modern high-performance stack: Traefik v3, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2 Async, React 19 with TanStack Router, TanStack Query, and Capacitor for mobile devices.
home.backendDesc: Fast health polling of FastAPI via Traefik v3 reverse proxy with local SSL.
home.postgresDesc: PostgreSQL 18 with asyncpg connection pooling and Alembic migrations.
home.mobileDesc: Dedicated package in pnpm workspace supporting iOS & Android with Preferences & Browser plugins.
home.modulesSubtitle: Every tier is fully isolated, type-safe, and production-ready.
home.secDesc: Argon2id password hashing, rotating JWT refresh tokens with jti, HttpOnly Cookies for Web, and Bearer storage for Capacitor.
home.orvalDesc: End-to-end codegen of React Query hooks and TypeScript models directly from FastAPI OpenAPI schema without a running server.
home.routerDesc: 100% type-safe routing with search params validation and clean file-based routing.
home.capDesc: Unified frontend codebase for Web, iOS, and Android with native platform APIs.
